verdict.rationale: A package manager could plausibly offer a natural-language command interface, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents conventional flag-based CLI commands (`bun add`, `bun update --interactive`, `--filter`, etc.) and an llms.txt docs file for LLM consumption. The llms.txt file helps external agents read the docs; it is not a way to operate Bun with natural-language commands, so no credit is given.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
